policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 10 Apr close (1x4 3.84, 3x6 3.89, 6x9 3.96, 9x12 4.07 vs WIBOR 3M 3.84) price roughly 25bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC held at 3.75% on 9 Apr; Glapiński sees no near-term change either way - hikes only in a 'black scenario' of renewed war, a question mark over cuts. Kotecki (2 Apr): the March cut was the last this year; Litwiniuk (2 Apr): no cuts soon, hikes possible if inflation worsens. March flash CPI 3.0% (31 Mar; 3.3% expected); core 2.5% in February. The fuel package (VAT 8%, minimum excise) takes ~0.9pp off April CPI (ING, PKO).
policy.risk_text: The ceasefire unwound much of the hike pricing; the risk is a breakdown of the truce (Hormuz still largely shut) re-pricing hikes, while the MPC's bar for a move either way is high. Long end: three April sales plus the USD issue, and a ~7% deficit.

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026 (Inflation Report, 6 Mar); the NBP forecaster survey (1 Apr) has 2026 CPI at 2.9%. The next projection comes in July.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit 7.2% of GDP (GUS preliminary, 1 Apr), debt 59.7%; 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; S&P (2-6 Apr) sees a 2026 deficit of 7.0% of GDP (8.0% in an oil-shock case); budget deficit after February PLN 48.5bn; fuel package (VAT 8%, minimum excise, price caps) from 27-31 Mar.
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~41% (end-Q1) financed; USD 6bn of 5Y/10Y/30Y priced on 7 Apr (UST +65/+105/+130bp); budget accounts PLN 169.5bn at end-March. No rating action in April; S&P reviews Poland on 8 May (A-, stable); Fitch A- and Moody's A2 have negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP cut to 3.75% on 4 Mar and held on 9 Apr; March CPI 3.0% y/y; 2025 GDP 3.6%, Q4 4.0%. Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. 10-12 Apr: MoF sold PLN 3.0bn of a new 50-week T-bill at 3.95% (offer 3-6bn, demand 3.6bn) plus 0.39bn additional; Domański: the war's impact is limited, no budget amendment needed, the fuel-excise cut stays after 15 Apr; PKO sees MoF supply plans as safe and neutral for the market; yields fell with core markets on 10 Apr. Abroad: US March CPI 3.3% (core 2.6%, slightly soft), UMich 1Y inflation expectations 4.8%; Brent ~$95 (-11% on the week); the Islamabad talks ended on 12 Apr without a deal and Trump ordered a naval blockade of Iran's ports; early Hungarian returns put Tisza ahead.

calendar.plan_text: MoF April plan (31 Mar): sale auctions on 15 Apr (PLN 4-12bn; OK0128, NZ0331, PS0731, DS1035, NZ0936), 23 Apr (6-14bn) and 28 Apr (5-13bn; new 10Y DS0436 replaces DS1035 from 23 Apr); no switch; a 50-week T-bill on 10 Apr (3-6bn). Q2 plan: 7-8 sales for PLN 50-90bn and 1-2 switches. 2026 needs ~41% financed at end-Q1. 7 Apr: USD 6bn issue (5Y 4.645%, 10Y 5.405%, 30Y 6.233%). 10 Apr T-bill: PLN 3.0bn at 3.95% (demand 3.6bn) plus 0.39bn.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; March's sell-off broke it. April is back to regular supply: remaining sales 15 Apr, 23 Apr, 28 Apr. Next MPC 5-6 May: a hold is expected; the July projection is the next marker.

facts.core_text: Regime: ceasefire relief - oil off its highs and hike pricing cut back everywhere; the NBP held at 3.75% on 9 Apr while FRAs price roughly 25bp of NBP hikes; the ECB and BoE are priced for hikes, the Fed is on hold, the CNB and MNB are on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 60bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 249bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 10 Apr close). Talks fail; Trump orders a Hormuz blockade (12 Apr).

quasi_takeaways: FPC fixed lines trade ~{lo}-{hi}bp over the POLGB curve (average {avg}bp); widest ASW {widest} at {widest_asw}bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: {best} ({best_sp}bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).
Supply: BGK's Q2 FPC calendar (31 Mar) has tenders on 16 and 29 Apr, 14 and 28 May and 18 Jun; on 26 Mar it sold only PLN 0.87bn (demand 1.06bn) plus 0.20bn.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
